SELECT examPaperQuestion.* , examPaper.paper_name AS paperName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examQuestion.question_type AS questionType , examQuestion.difficulty_level AS difficultyLevel FROM exam_paper_question examPaperQuestion LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examPaperQuestion.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examPaperQuestion.question_id = examQuestion.id
ORDER BY CASE examQuestion.question_type WHEN 1 THEN 1 /* 单选 */ WHEN 2 THEN 2 /* 多选 */ WHEN 3 THEN 3 /* 填空，保留 */ WHEN 4 THEN 4 /* 判断，保留 */ ELSE 5 /* 主观题 */ END ASC, examPaperQuestion.sort_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
